karty.priklad: Mae hi'n gwisgo gormod o golur.
karty.priklad_cs: She wears too much make-up (colur → [g]olur after o).
karty.mnemo: COLOUR (COLUR) for your face: ice-blue eyeshadow.

extra.pozn: gwisgo colur = to wear make-up; coluro = to make up (outside the coursebook); the book gives no plural; own example

karty.priklad: Daethon nhw o hyd i drysor yn yr hen gastell.
karty.priklad_cs: They found treasure in the old castle (trysor → [d]rysor after i; castell → [g]astell after hen).
karty.mnemo: TREASURE (TRYSOR): a chest glittering with sapphires.

extra.pozn: helfa drysor (L15); trysori = to treasure (outside the coursebook); dod o hyd i (L8); own example

karty.priklad: Mae pobl yn dweud bod ysbryd yn yr hen dŷ.
karty.priklad_cs: People say there's a ghost in the old house (tŷ → [d]ŷ after hen).
karty.mnemo: ysBRYD ~ SPIRIT (Latin spiritus): a pale blue ghost riding a walrus.

extra.pozn: also ysbryd tîm = team spirit; ysbrydol = spiritual, Ysbryd Glân = Holy Spirit (outside the coursebook); own example

sever.priklad: Mae pobl yn deud bod ysbryd yn yr hen dŷ.
sever.priklad_cs: People say there's a ghost in the old house (tŷ → [d]ŷ after hen).
sever.pozn: north: deud instead of dweud (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Cymharwch y penwythnos nesa a'r penwythnos diwetha.
karty.priklad_cs: Compare next weekend and last weekend.

extra.pozn: cymharu X â Y = to compare X with Y (aspirate mutation after â); cymhariaeth = comparison, cymharol = comparatively (outside the coursebook); sentence from the Gêm o Gardiau, p. 241; TO BE CHECKED: a'r or â'r in the book

karty.cs: to affect, to have an effect (on)
karty.priklad: Ydy'r tywydd yn effeithio ar eich hwyliau chi?
karty.priklad_cs: Does the weather affect your mood?
karty.mnemo: Like English EFFECT (EFFEITH-io): an effect on your mood.

extra.pozn: effaith = effect (L9); hwyliau = plural of hwyl (L10); sentence from the Gêm o Gardiau, p. 241

karty.priklad: Dw i'n defnyddio fy Nghymraeg yn gyson erbyn hyn.
karty.priklad_cs: I use my Welsh regularly now (cyson → [g]yson after yn; Cymraeg → [Ngh]ymraeg after fy).
karty.mnemo: cySON ~ uniSON: always on the same note.

extra.pozn: yn gyson = regularly, constantly; cysondeb = consistency (outside the coursebook); own example on the topic Siaradwch – Y Gymraeg, p. 245

karty.priklad: Mae fflat ar osod uwchben y siop.
karty.priklad_cs: There's a flat to let above the shop (gosod → [o]sod after ar).
karty.mnemo: gosod = to place, to set (L7): the flat is set out for letting.

extra.pozn: ar werth = for sale (outside the coursebook); uwchben (L16), rhentu (L9); also in Robin Radio, p. 249; own example

karty.priklad: Rhaid i ni gael gwared ar yr hen soffa cyn symud.
karty.priklad_cs: We must get rid of the old sofa before moving (cael → [g]ael after i ni).
karty.mnemo: Get rid of it – heave it over the GUARDrail (GWAR-ed).

extra.pozn: cael is irregular (ces i, cest ti, cafodd e…); same pattern as cael hyd i, cael blas ar (L12); own example

karty.priklad: Dere at y ffenest i godi llaw ar Anti Mair!
karty.priklad_cs: Come to the window to wave to Auntie Mair! (codi → [g]odi after i)
karty.mnemo: codi (to raise) + llaw (hand): to raise your hand.

extra.pozn: codi ofn ar (L7); Anti Mair from Robin Radio; own example

sever.priklad: Tyrd at y ffenest i godi llaw ar Anti Mair!
sever.priklad_cs: Come to the window to wave to Auntie Mair! (codi → [g]odi after i)
sever.pozn: north: tyrd! instead of dere! (Y De a'r Gogledd, L19, p. 249)

karty.cs: to keep at it, to persevere
karty.priklad: Daliwch ati – mae'ch Cymraeg chi'n gwella bob dydd!
karty.priklad_cs: Keep at it – your Welsh is getting better every day! (pob → [b]ob in an expression of time)
karty.mnemo: dal (to hold) + ati (at it): hold on to it.

extra.pozn: ati = at + hi (at it); imperative Dalia ati! / Daliwch ati! = Keep it up!; parhau = to continue (L12); own example

karty.priklad: Daeth pobl y pentre at ei gilydd i helpu'r teulu ar ôl y llif.
karty.priklad_cs: The village people came together to help the family after the flood (cilydd → [g]ilydd after ei).
karty.mnemo: at (to) + ei gilydd (each other): to come to each other.

extra.pozn: ei gilydd = each other (cilydd → gilydd after ei); it changes with the person: dod at ein gilydd (we), at eich gilydd (you), at ei gilydd (they); gyda'i gilydd = together (p. 247); dod is irregular (des i, daeth e…); llif (L11); own example

karty.slovo: Wnei di fod yn was priodas?
karty.priklad: Gofynnodd Alejandro i Robin fod yn was priodas.
karty.priklad_cs: Alejandro asked Robin to be his best man (bod → [f]od after i Robin; gwas → [w]as after yn).
karty.mnemo: gwas (servant) + priodas (wedding): the servant at the wedding.

extra.pozn: gwas priodas (m) = best man, morwyn briodas (f) = bridesmaid (outside the coursebook; morwyn L10); Wnei di…? = short future of gwneud (L4, L5); phrase from Robin Radio, p. 249; own example, the PDF doesn't say who the best man is

karty.priklad: Mae Anti Mair yn priodi yn yr haf? Am gyffrous!
karty.priklad_cs: Auntie Mair is getting married in the summer? How exciting! (cyffrous → [g]yffrous after am)
karty.mnemo: cyffrous (exciting) → gyffrous after am: what an exciting thing!

extra.pozn: am + adjective with soft mutation = How…! (Am hyfryd!, Am le braf! – outside the coursebook); cyffroi = to excite (L20); phrase from Robin Radio, p. 249; own example
